records.label: spacr.restart_state#3
records.source: Two further records live in the preference store rather than in a file. The last session (module, its settings and its folder) is written while spaCR runs and when it closes, so an ordinary start can reopen where the user left off after any exit or crash. Settings drafts hold the unsaved settings of every open module; they are cleared on a clean exit, so a draft found at start-up means the previous run ended without closing.
records.context: Two further records live in the preference store rather than in a file. The last session (module, its settings and its folder) is written while spaCR runs and when it closes, so an ordinary start can reopen where the user left off after any exit or crash. Settings drafts hold the unsaved settings of every open module; they are cleared on a clean exit, so a draft found at start-up means the previous processing session ended without closing.
